description: Run hosted sponsored research without a buyer wallet, funding or API key. Requires publicReport: true: your question and trial report become public. Server quota, pause and spending limits apply; source budget is 0–0.08 USDC, separate from model/search costs. This creates a new research run and may contact external sources. No automatic retry or paid fallback. Timeouts/disconnects may leave server work running; do not resend automatically. For a separately authorized purchase from your own funded wallet, use the paid buyer tool ask_keryx.

budget.description: Source budget in USDC, 0–0.08 inclusive. Zero is valid. Separate from model/search operating costs; service limits still apply.

mode.description: Hosted research mode: quick or deep (service default when omitted).

publicReport.description: Required explicit consent: the question and resulting trial report are public.
